g.style: fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; opacity: 1;

path.style: fill: rgb(255, 191, 0); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: rgb(204, 153, 0); stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; text-anchor: start; opacity: 1;

text.style: fill: rgb(255, 255, 255); fill-opacity: 1; stroke: none; stroke-width: 1px; stroke-opacity: 1; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; text-anchor: middle; opacity: 1; font-family: "DejaVu Sans", sans-serif;
